notes.title: Deluxe version update!
notes.content:
Throne Quest Deluxe is an improved version of the game, available to all current owners as a free update. There are a few cosmetic and gameplay changes; 

- 50 Achievements have been added to the game
- HUGE endgame dungeon has been added with plenty of strong monsters to combat
- Two new bosses added to the endgame dungeon
- Extended soundtrack
- Special Powers - Added multiple different class-specific abilities for special powers, including projectile showers and slow motion
- Special Power - increased rate of generation
- Gamepad - Improved hotbar controls (appearance and functionality)
- Time of Day added, lighting in overworld map changes according to time
- Sleeping in beds skip nighttime into daytime
- Decorative objects on map - grasslands and dungeons
- Gameplay - monsters HP doesn't reset when they fall off-screen. Most noticeable with bosses, who don't auto-heal to 100% if they jump off-screen
- Mapping - Some emptyish caves have been fixed, their monsters weren't loading properly
- Performance - General increase in performance
- Able to navigate back to main menu from in-game
- Bugfix - Dropping equipped item will now un-equip it
- Bugfix - Central caslte icon not showing
- Bugfix - Item prices now take item rank into consideration
- Bugfix - Can now see item stats in shop before buying
- Bugfix - Fixed bug where you could buy 1 item without having enough money

Please follow me on socials/discord for more updates and news http://.linktr.ee/valorware
